source: Iced-Cream's own tests on their unit: the core-ar2 0.4 unit test (P4A4, Q4A4 and U4A4, 2026-10-21, runs T22, T23 and T25; rytm2_mods core-pages, released as v1.3) for 1.2; 1.1's run (C3A4, 2026-10-20) and 1.0's (R2T3, 2026-10-14) are kept below for the module's unchanged parts
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-21, P4A4 (core-ar2 0.4 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports, lfo-rnd 1.2 through core_pages and core_params): LFO pressed twice opened LFO RND with DS1, DS2, DP1 and DP2; DS1 opened the destination list and YES confirmed FRQ; with DP1 32 the cutoff varied from note to note and with DP1 0 it did not; the four settings were kept through a kit save, power cycle and reload, and through a power cycle without a kit save; a kit saved with lfo-rnd 1.0 showed and played its settings and kept an edit through a power cycle. Q4A4 (the LFO key's list through core_view_pages) passed the page keys beside the other mods. U4A4 (the bytes of rytm2_mods v1.3, this folder's source) stepped LFO, LFO RND, LFO with the header following. Hardware, OS 1.74, 2026-10-20, C3A4 (core-ar2 0.3, lfo-rnd 1.1): the same six steps passed, and the settings were kept through the +Drive sound library and a kit sent and received by SysEx and by Overbridge. Hardware, 2026-11-05, V14H (core-ar2 0.10, all eleven ports with this release object): load baseline CPU 80.0 % idle, 96 % with notes on eight voice tracks, for the whole set.
scope: lfo-rnd 1.2 beside the other rytm2_mods ports on core-ar2 0.4 (P4A4, Q4A4, U4A4) and 0.10 (V14H). lfo-rnd 1.1 beside the other ports on core-ar2 0.3 (C3A4). Not this package on Modwerk's base.

builds.label: P4A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.4 (first version) with rytm2_mods' eleven OS 1.74 mods, lfo-rnd 1.2 among them (rytm2_mods core-pages 7ff47d7, before the page-key list). Flashed by the owner, test steps run by hand, stock 1.74 restored.
results: LFO pressed twice opens LFO RND; DS1 opens the list, YES confirms FRQ; DP1 32 varies the cutoff note to note, DP1 0 does not.
The four settings are kept through kit save, power cycle and reload, and through a power cycle without a kit save.
A kit saved with lfo-rnd 1.0 keeps its settings, and an edit to it survives a power cycle.

builds.label: Q4A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.4's second version with the same eleven mods; lfo-rnd's LFO key list through core_view_pages (rytm2_mods d20f352). .syx aeeefc50… (prefix as logged).
results: The page keys step through stock's pages and each mod's beside the other mods.

builds.label: U4A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.4's final version with the same eleven mods: the bytes of rytm2_mods v1.3, this folder's source.
results: LFO steps LFO, LFO RND, LFO with the header following; the module's six steps were not repeated.

builds.label: V14H
builds.content: core-ar2 0.10 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports (this release object among them) and analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys; a load baseline.
results: The whole set: CPU 80.0 % / DSP 74.8 % idle, 96 % / 88.6 % with notes on eight voice tracks. This module's share was not separated.

builds.label: C3A4
builds.content: core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods v1.2 ports, lfo-rnd 1.1 among them.
results: Steps 1 to 6 pass; the settings are kept through the +Drive sound library and a kit sent and received by SysEx and by Overbridge.

limitations: Not yet run from this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7).
P4A4 ran the source before the page-key list; U4A4 ran this folder's bytes, but only the page step and header were checked on it.
Firmware was not read back from the device.
